title: Mitigating Performance Discrepancy in Cross-Domain 3D Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.04860v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D perception plays a crucial role in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and AR/VR. In practical scenarios, 3D perception models need to continually adapt to newly emerging 3D object categories, making class-incremental learning (CIL) particularly important. However, unlike 2D images, 3D point clouds are inherently heterogeneous: objects from the same class may not only come from the clean CAD domain, but also from RGB-D camera scans of varying quality, video reconstructions, or even corrupted observations. We discover that such heterogeneity introduces a new challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting: the degree of performance degradation can vary substantially across domains, a phenomenon we term performance discrepancy. translated_title: 缓解跨域3D类增量学习中的性能差异
translated_abstract: 3D感知在自动驾驶、机器人和AR/VR等现实应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。在实际场景中，3D感知模型需要不断适应新出现的3D物体类别，这使得类增量学习（CIL）变得尤为重要。然而，与2D图像不同，3D点云本质上具有异构性：同一类别的物体不仅可能来自干净的CAD领域，还可能来自质量不一的RGB-D相机扫描、视频重建，甚至是损坏的观测数据。我们发现这种异构性带来了一个超越灾难性遗忘的新挑战：性能下降的程度在不同领域之间可能存在显著差异，我们将这种现象称为性能差异。为了研究这一问题，我们建立了Domain3D-CIL训练与评估协议，其中包含来自异构领域的点云类别。我们进一步对广泛的……
tldr: 该论文揭示了跨域3D类增量学习中超越灾难性遗忘的新挑战——不同领域间性能下降程度差异显著的“性能差异”现象，并建立了Domain3D-CIL基准协议来研究和应对这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "performance discrepancy"—a new challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting in cross-domain 3D class-incremental learning, where performance degradation varies substantially across heterogeneous domains—and establishes the Domain3D-CIL training and evaluation protocol to investigate and address this problem.
